title: The cut title's face
note: Which of the twenty-four faces the cut title morphs INTO. The Front Screen ships the word as one baked Friz outline and cut-morph.ts swaps it for the same outlines split into eight, tweened against the Turn; this Bake writes both the shortlist the sheet reads and the one face the page carries, into src/sections/front-screen/assets/cut-morph.json.
needs: the font files, which are not in this repository - run it beside friz/, gf/ and fsf/ as design/cut-title/morph/README.md describes. Without them there is nothing to build from and the run stops before it writes anything.

groups.name: Which of the twenty-four
groups.note: Ranked in design/cut-title/morph/ranking.csv, with a blurb each in faces.json. The four kinds the tuner grouped them by - grotesk, display, soft, geometric - are fields on those entries rather than an axis here.

params.label: face
params.note: The face the word morphs INTO. At t = 0 every one of the twenty-four is identical, because they are all Friz there. Host Grotesk is OFL; the twelve Fontshare faces are free for commercial use and are not, so choosing one of those reopens a licensing question.
